row: I'm a veterinary technician with over five years in vet clinics, and this channel translates pet health into plain English. Why does your dog eat grass? Is grain-free food actually better? How do you know if your cat is in pain? Expect short, honest, science-backed explainers with zero jargon and zero fear-mongering. New videos every Wednesday and Saturday. Important: I'm a vet tech, not a veterinarian. Everything here is general information, not medical advice — always check with your own vet about your pet.
